saw_lines: Glasses buyers rarely stop at one pair. They buy one for work, one for weekends, and often a sunglass pair too.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer choosing a second pair needs a reason to buy.
Your site shows 500,000+ happy customers and 6000 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number. Put 6000 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 20 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 500,000+ happy customers and 6000 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number, so cold buyers have no proof to act on. Put 6000 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 15% off when you buy two pairs, but 0 of 22 ads mention any offer, so a first-time buyer has no reason to act today. Lead three new ads with the 15% off two pairs on the creative.

Your ads open with 10 different stories, and the Swiss design opener leads 5 of them, so no single story gets built out. Pick the two strongest stories and build the next batch from them, three variations each.
11 of your ads have run 60+ days, so they are the base to build from. Build three more versions of the oldest winner, changing the first line and keeping the video format.

ads_1: New openers replacing Swiss design, with the 15% off two pairs up front
